# Tourism Review

> > Global tourism intelligence covering industry trends, destination statistics, aviation developments, and sustainable travel insights from UNWTO and international markets.

Tourism Review provides comprehensive coverage of the international tourism industry, featuring analysis from experts like Vanderlei J. Pollack and Kevin Eagan. The platform tracks tourism statistics, aviation news from major players like Airbus and Boeing, and destination developments across key markets including Germany, China, Spain, Turkey, and emerging regions.

## Key Topics

- UNWTO (UN World Tourism Organization)
- International tourism statistics
- Aviation industry (Airbus, Boeing, Eurocontrol)
- Chinese tourists and outbound travel
- Mass tourism and overtourism
- Sustainable tourism and biodiversity
- Tourism marketing and AI technology
- MICE industry (meetings, conferences)
- Sports tourism
- Mediterranean destinations
- Thailand tourism
- Russian tourists
- Tourism fees and taxation
- Destination management
- Travel trends and innovation

## Industry Trends & Analysis

- [Global Tourism Trends](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/trends-for-tourism): Tourism trends: AI technology, experience tourism & industry innovations
- [UNWTO Reports & Statistics](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/unwto): UNWTO news: UN World Tourism Organization statistics & pandemic recovery
- [Tourism Marketing Strategies](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/tourism-marketing): Tourism marketing: Sojern, AI, digital & destination management strategies
- [Economic Impact of Tourism](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/importance-of-tourism): Tourism importance: Bavaria, France economics & international revenues

## Top Destinations & Regional Markets

- [Mediterranean Tourism](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/mediterranean-destinations): Mediterranean destinations: Egypt, Spain, Turkey, climate impact & LGBTQ
- [Thailand Tourism Market](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/thailand-tourism): Thailand tourism: visa waivers, Chinese tourists & arrivals statistics
- [Bangkok Destination](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/destination-bangkok): Bangkok destination: Thailand tourism, Chinese visitors & SE Asia travel
- [Turkey Travel Market](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/turkey-destination): Turkey destination: Russian, German, UK tourists & health tourism stats
- [Top European Destinations](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/top-destinations): Top destinations: Italy (Puglia, Sardinia, Sicily) rankings & travel trends

- [NIKI Airlines](http://www.tourism-review.com/outcome/niki-airlines): NIKI Airlines: Greece, Mediterranean, airline industry travel news
